installer.welcomeSetupSub: Saba-chan downloads game modules and sets up Python and the saba-chan command. This happens only once.
installer.labelSetup: What Saba-chan prepares on this Mac
installer.setupCommand: The saba-chan command (for Terminal and AI agents)
installer.setupModules: The game modules you pick and the extensions they need
installer.hintSetup: Saba-chan stays inside the app in your Applications folder. There is no install location to choose.
installer.hintModulesSetup: You can pick only the games that run on this Mac. You can get more in Saba Storage later.
installer.setupCompleteSub: You can now use the saba-chan command in a new Terminal window.
installer.moveFirstSub: Saba-chan is running from the disk image or a temporary place. Drag it into the Applications folder, then open it from there.
installer.hintComponents: Modules and extensions go in the modules and extensions folders here. Files already installed are moved.
installer.compNotAbsolute: Choose a full folder path, such as D:\Games\Saba.
installer.compRootOrHome: Choose a folder inside a drive or your user folder, not the drive itself or your user folder.
installer.compOverlap: This folder overlaps the current modules or extensions folder. Choose another folder.
installer.compInsideInstall: This folder is inside the install folder, or would put modules and extensions inside each other. Choose another folder.
installer.compInvalid: Saba-chan can't use this folder for modules and extensions. Choose another folder.
installer.errComponentsDir: Couldn't move the modules and extensions. Nothing was changed. Choose another folder or try again.
installer.errInstallDir: This folder can't hold Saba-chan. Choose a folder that isn't a drive root, your home folder, or the settings folder.
installer.hintChannel: Installs the latest release of this channel, and later updates come from it too. You can change it in the app settings after installing.
installer.privacyNotice: Saba-chan sends an anonymous ID and version numbers to the Saba-chan server to check for updates and to show the module and extension lists. You can turn off automatic update checks in the app settings. Discord features send data only after you connect them. Privacy policy: saba-chan.online/legal/privacy
installer.modulesUnavailable: Could not load the game module list. You can add modules in the app after installing.
installer.completeWarnings: Installed, but some steps had problems:
installer.errElevation: Couldn't get administrator rights to create the install folder. Pick another folder or allow the prompt.
installer.errOutdated: This installer is too old for the current release. Download the latest installer from the website.
installer.errIncomplete: This release is incomplete, so nothing was installed. Try again later.
installer.errProfile: Couldn't switch the install type (desktop/no GUI). Close Saba-chan and try again.
installer.errDownload: Download failed. Check your internet connection and try again.
installer.errExtract: Couldn't write the files. Close Saba-chan and any running servers, then try again.
installer.errElsewhere: Saba-chan is already installed in another folder. Update or remove that install first (only one install per PC is supported).
installer.errDaemonRunning: Saba-chan is running and the installer can't tell which install it belongs to. Quit Saba-chan first, then try again.
installer.launchFailed: Couldn't start Saba-chan. Start it from the Start menu or desktop shortcut.
installer.errChannelOlder: The latest release on this channel is older than this installer, so it can't be installed from this channel. Choose another channel.
installer.uninstallDesc: This removes the Saba-chan program and every file it made: runtimes, modules, caches, logs, temporary files, shortcuts and registry entries. Running servers are stopped first. Choose below what to keep.
installer.uninstallKeepInstancesHint: Keeps server files, worlds, backups and each server's settings so a reinstall picks them up.
installer.uninstallKeepSettingsHint: Keeps app settings and the Discord connection so a reinstall picks them up.
installer.uninstallCompletePartial: Uninstalled, but some files are left
installer.uninstallCompletePartialSub: These could not be deleted. Close any program using them and delete them yourself:
installer.uninstallWarnServersUnlisted: Could not get the list of running servers, so they were force-stopped instead of shut down cleanly ({{detail}}).
installer.uninstallWarnServerForceStopped: Server {{server}} did not shut down cleanly and was force-stopped ({{detail}}). Changes since its last save may be lost.
installer.uninstallWarnDaemonUnanswered: The daemon did not answer, so running servers were force-stopped. Changes since their last save may be lost.
installer.uninstallProgressSandbox: Removing isolation profiles and folder permissions...
installer.uninstallProgressData: Removing user data and runtime environments...
installer.uninstallProgressDataKeep: Removing runtime environments (keeping what you chose)...

updater.relaunchFailedSub: The update is applied. Please start Saba-chan yourself.
updater.rollbackRelaunchFailedSub: The update was rolled back to the previous version, but Saba-chan could not be restarted. Please start it yourself.
updater.restoreFailedLead: Some of the rollback could not be completed. Before starting Saba-chan, follow these steps.
updater.leftInPlaceLead: The new version did not start properly and could not be stopped. To undo the update, follow these steps.
updater.recoverStop: Quit Saba-chan and end every saba-core process (Task Manager / Activity Monitor).
updater.recoverExes: Restore the programs: copy each file on the left over the file on the right: {{list}}
updater.recoverMissingCore: No saba-core backup was found in {{installDir}}. Reinstall the previous version with its installer.
updater.recoverData: Copy the contents of {{data}} into {{dataDir}} and the contents of {{instances}} into {{instancesDir}}, overwriting.
